AspendoraSearchKeywords.ReportDocumentation: Google Search Console keyword performance imported daily. Clicks and impressions are summed over the selected period; average position is impression-weighted. GSC data lags about 3 days behind.
AspendoraSearchKeywords.BingKeywordsDocumentation: Bing Webmaster Tools keyword performance, imported daily. Bing only publishes keyword stats in weekly buckets: a week is included when its bucket date falls inside the selected period, so a single day (or a short range with no bucket date) will usually show nothing - use week, month or year. Clicks and impressions are summed; average position is impression-weighted.
AspendoraSearchKeywords.BingPagesDocumentation: Bing Webmaster Tools per-page search performance (weekly buckets, same rules as Bing Keywords). Clicks and impressions are summed over the period; average position is impression-weighted.
AspendoraSearchKeywords.BingCrawlStatsDocumentation: Daily Bing crawl counters for the selected period, one row per day: pages crawled, URLs in the Bing index, inbound links, HTTP status counts, crawl errors and URLs blocked by robots.txt. Values are Bing's daily figures and are not summed.
AspendoraSearchKeywords.BingCrawlIssuesDocumentation: The current list of URLs Bing reports crawl problems for (redirects, 4xx/5xx, robots.txt blocks, DNS or timeout errors). This is the latest snapshot and does not change with the selected date; it is replaced on every daily import.
